properties.name: Via Maris
properties.context: "Way of the Sea" — Israel deliberately avoided this road fleeing Egypt (Exod 13:17); Abraham traveled it to Egypt (Gen 12)
properties.description: The coastal highway from Egypt to Mesopotamia; the primary international road of the ancient Near East, running along the Mediterranean coast through Canaan.

properties.name: King's Highway
properties.context: Moses asked Edom for permission to cross this road during the Exodus (Num 20:17)
properties.description: The Transjordanian highland road running north–south through Edom, Moab, Ammon, and Gilead. A major route for trade and military movement east of the Jordan River.

properties.name: Incense Route
properties.context: Arabia-to-Mediterranean spice road; the Queen of Sheba traveled a version of this to visit Solomon (1 Kgs 10)
properties.description: The Arabian spice and incense road from Sheba (Yemen) through the Hijaz and Nabatea to the Mediterranean ports. Carried frankincense, myrrh, and eastern spices.

properties.name: Euphrates Route
properties.context: Abraham's migration path from Ur through Haran down to Canaan (Gen 11–12)
properties.description: The inland route following the Euphrates River connecting Mesopotamia (Babylon, Ur) with northern Syria and Anatolia. Used by Abraham's migration from Ur to Haran.
